correctness.rationale: For n>=7, an initial ordinary force by four seeds requires one of two cubic-graph induced P3 templates; a finite check of their neighbors shows exactly four permissible fourth seeds in each case and these force two consecutive full columns, ensuring propagation. Three seeds cannot force the full prism. Symmetry reduction yields five orbits with stabilizers (2,1,1,4,2). Every exchange is a pair of motifs sharing three selected vertices, producing the explicit five-by-five neighbor table; the support-width bound makes the comparison uniform for n>=11, and n7..10 wraps are checked separately. The orbit-weighted degree sum is 96n and exchange connectivity has explicit paths. Inspecting all token slides from each template finds no admissible neighbor. A fresh verifier independently reconstructs the blue forcing rule, exhausts all k=3/4 choices for n7..12, tests all orbits, reconfigurations, exact neighbor matrix and connectivity, and checks local fourth-seed lists through n24; reports VERIFY_OK. Finite tests corroborate, not replace, the all-order proof.
